relationships: English Application Number / Application Details and Arabic رقم الطلب / تفاصيل الطلب use the same localization keys for the same application page.
This is a page- and operation-scoped lexical equivalence; it does not equate every occurrence of request with an application.
Public applicationNumber and workflow taskId remain distinct: use a verified record lookup and the actual current response.
constraints: Use only the named page, operation and data path after identity and permission checks. The definition grants no access and supplies no current counts, status, handler or outcome.
Tickets, enquiries, workflow tasks and issued license certificates remain distinct entities. An ambiguous request outside this page context must not use this alias.
